title: 第十九章 林爷以后不虚了求追读求月票第二十章 狐狸来访
slug: 从效法万妖开始成就真仙
lines: 对于旁人而言，纳气数量是极为关键的一点。
毕竟这意味着斗法中能否使出更强悍的仙法，以及能用多少次。
但对林舒来说，这玩意儿的重要程度还要更胜一筹。
别人耗尽灵力大不了再补，自己若是耗尽，那可就没命了，自然是存的越多越好。
“无论怎么说，总算是解决掉一个大麻烦。”
林舒缓缓睁开眼眸，颇有些感慨。
看来自己运气还是不错的。
一缕灵力相当于先前三成的白狼雾气。
现在手握十缕，消耗还能靠吐纳补充。
总算不必那么拮据了。
哪怕全力施展幽月裂骨手，也能使个七八回的。
听起来好像不是很多。
但要知道，幽月手可是六品仙法，属于中三品，本该是练气中期修士使用的手段。
也难怪用一次就差点要了自己的命。
林舒把玩着恶钱，低头看向心口。
他眸中闪过一丝异样。
这白狼虚影，好像有些不一般啊。
善功恶钱这种玄妙之物，都没能直接把青鸟仙体凝聚出来，只换来一本内法。
白狼虚影却是寄生在前身一介凡人体内。
再加之心脏被挖走，仿佛给它留了个窝似的。
要说不是有人刻意为之，林舒是不信的。
不过他并不急。
反正续命之法有了，时日还长，总能将事情搞清楚，弄到补全心脏的法子，彻底解决掉这个麻烦。
“灵力现在是管够，就看你表现了。”
或许是青鸟太黑心，林舒现在看着这狗崽子都眉清目秀起来。
整整二十枚善功，就换个练气八品仙法，还只提升到小成。
人家狗崽子吞了八枚恶钱，便吐了个六品仙法，不仅小成，顺带还给换了个名字。
瞧瞧这区别！
林舒抓起一把恶钱，干脆利落的按了下去。
果然没有辜负他的期待。
白狼虚影还是一如既往的大方。
仅仅五枚恶钱下去，幽月裂骨手便突破至大成，待到它消化完第十枚恶钱，第二条提示便蹿了出来。
【练气六品.幽月裂骨手：圆满】
从头到尾一气呵成，没有丝毫停顿。
顺利的让林舒都怔了一下，但很快，曾经的那抹燥意倏然涌上心头。
且来势汹汹，让人难以抵抗。
林舒眼角抽搐，原本黑白分明的眸子，此刻渐渐有血丝蔓延开来。
content_en:
;;
For others, the amount of Qi received is an extremely critical point.
After all, this means whether more powerful immortal magic can be used in the battle, and how many times it can be used.
But to Lin Shu, this thing is even more important.
If others use up their spiritual energy, they will not be able to replenish it. If they use up their spiritual energy, they will be dead. Naturally, the more they can save, the better.
"Anyway, we finally solved a big problem."
Lin Shu slowly opened his eyes, feeling quite emotional.
It seems that I have good luck.
A ray of spiritual power is equivalent to 30% of the previous white wolf mist.
Now I hold ten strands in my hand, and the consumption can be replenished by breathing in and out.
Finally, we don’t have to be so tight anymore.
Even if you use the Youyue Bone Splitting Hand with all your strength, you can still do it seven or eight times.
That doesn't sound like a lot.
But you must know that Youyue Hand is a sixth-grade immortal method, belonging to the middle-third grade. It should be a method used by monks in the middle stage of Qi training.
No wonder it almost killed him after using it once.
"..."
Lin Shu played with the bad money and looked down at his heart.
There was something strange in his eyes.
This white wolf phantom seems a little unusual.
Mysterious things like good deeds and evil money could not directly condense the Blue Bird Immortal Body, only an internal method was obtained.
The white wolf shadow is parasitic in the body of a mortal in his predecessor.
In addition, the heart was dug out, as if a nest was left for it.
Lin Shu didn't believe it if someone didn't do it deliberately.
But he was in no hurry.
Anyway, there is a way to extend his life. As time goes by, he can always figure things out, find a way to replenish his heart, and completely solve this problem.
"The spiritual power is sufficient now, it depends on your performance."
Maybe it was because Qingniao was too evil-minded, but Lin Shu looked at this bastard with a clear face now.
After a total of twenty good skills, I changed to the eighth-level Qi training immortal method, and it was only improved to Xiaocheng.
This little brat swallowed eight bad coins and spit out a sixth-grade immortal magic. Not only did he achieve success, but he also changed his name.
Look at the difference!
Lin Shu grabbed a handful of bad money and pressed it down neatly.
It certainly lived up to his expectations.
White Wolf Phantom is still as generous as ever.
After only five bad coins, You Yue's Bone Splitting Hand reached great success. When it finished digesting the tenth bad coin, the second prompt popped up.
[Sixth level of Qi training. Youyue Bone Splitting Hand: Perfection]
It was done in one breath from beginning to end, without any pause.
Lin Shu was stunned for a moment by the success, but soon, the feeling of boredom that he once felt suddenly came to his mind.
And it is so fierce that it is difficult to resist.
Lin Shu's eyes twitched, and his originally black and white eyes gradually became bloodshot.
